LanguageData.CK_VerticalWarehouse.label: vertical warehouse
LanguageData.CK_VerticalWarehouse.description: A 3x3 internal warehouse. Colonists can drop items into it and take them out from the inspect pane; contents are stored inside and do not occupy map cells. Connect a conveyor on a side for automatic input/output; internal temperature is adjustable and defaults to 4°C.
